title: How big should battles be?
author: Just-Routine967
selftext:
3000v3000 performance test for large set piece battles ☺️ is it too chaotic or do I go higher?

I've always wanted something like the persistent scenarios (Liberation, CTI) from Arma 3 but at a much larger scifi scale, I think it's shaping up well.

Don't have much of value to add in terms of workflow tips, it's just been an Opus overseer coordinating sessions with their own sections to implement. Blender + Godot and one Tripo model (the ally soldier)

comments.author: deject3d
comments.body: is more big more fun? what tradeoffs are being made?

replies.author: Just-Routine967
replies.body:
I think it's fun watching waves of dropships coming in, drop pods streaking down from the flagship, knowing it isn't just random background set dressing but all fully simulated.
But I'm pretty biased as fps/strategy games of this scale are niche so my bar isn't high.

Tradeoffs?

replies.author: deject3d
replies.body: certainly there are some tradeoffs being made in the AI fidelity or design that enables you to accomodate 6000 units

replies.author: Just-Routine967
replies.body:
They don't have much agency beyond their orders currently, similar to most rts units. 
Maybe once I implement a smart order system that gives them more autonomy similar to Steel Division 2 I'll have to make tradeoffs but at the moment the only thing bottlenecking it is the crowd animations still being CPU bound.
